source.note: Wave-1 row 40 named Quaternius Low Poly Sea Animals (poly.pizza, behind a Cloudflare challenge). This is the Manta ray from Quaternius's Animated Fish pack on OpenGameArt (CC0; the same zip as the koi and shark entries, the same mesh family as itch.io 'LowPoly Animated Fish'). Its only clip is Swim, a slow 4.25 s wing-beat loop (the pectoral wings flap down and up, cephalic fins and whip tail follow). Coloured in the indigo script as a navy back over a white belly, like a reef manta's dark dorsal and pale ventral sides (the mesh has no shoulder patches). Sized by wingspan, not height: at the source's proportions a rest height of 0.719 m (belly to the dorsal fin tip) gives a 4.49 m wingspan, a typical adult reef manta (3 to 5 m); the stylized whip tail makes the nose-to-tail length 6.28 m, longer than a real manta's. A fish has no ground: like every entry its lowest rest point is at y = 0; films lift it into the water.
